literal_meaning: জোর করে তলব করা (forceful demand or summons)
figurative_meaning_bn: অবিলম্বে হাজির হবার কড়া হুকুম বা ডাক
figurative_meaning_en: A strict order or urgent call to appear immediately without delay
example_sentences_in_bangla: পুলিশ তার বিরুদ্ধে জোরতলব জারি করেছে।
অফিস থেকে জোরতলব এলে অবিলম্বে যেতে হবে।
example_sentences_in_english: The police have issued a zor-tolob against him.
If there's a zor-tolob from the office, you must go immediately.
note: This idiom is commonly used in formal and legal contexts in Bengali-speaking regions, reflecting administrative practices.
